saints.name: St. Benjamin
saints.title: Deacon and Martyr
saints.shortBlurb: A Persian deacon who would not stop preaching the Gospel and was martyred with cruel torture under King Bahram V…
biography: Benjamin was a deacon in Persia during the persecution begun under King Yazdegerd I and continued by his son Bahram V. Imprisoned for a year, he was offered his freedom on condition that he cease to preach, but he refused to be silent about Christ.
For this steadfastness he was subjected to savage torture and put to death about the year 424. He is honored in the East and West as one of the martyrs of the Persian Church.
saints.knownFor: Refusing to be silent about the Gospel, unto martyrdom.
